name: agentshelf
description: Single-plugin marketplace by xelA31B: Agentic commerce audit: check against public standards (schema.org Product/Offer, return and shipping policies, merchant feeds, robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, OAuth, MCP) whether AI agents can find, understand and buy from your store, booking site or API. Evidence for every finding, a simulated agent shopping test, ready-to-paste fixes and scheduled re-checks.
